name: What is the typical timeline for wheelchair ramp installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for wheelchair ramp installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for a wheelchair ramp depends on its complexity and type. Portable ramps can be set up almost immediately. Modular ramps usually take a few days to a week for assembly and proper placement. Custom-built ramps, especially those requiring significant construction, design, and potentially permits, can take several weeks from initial consultation to completion. This includes time for design, material sourcing, site preparation, and construction. We prioritize efficiency while ensuring quality and compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation timelines range from immediate for portable ramps to several weeks for custom-built ramps requiring design, permits, and construction.
